prompts.remote: Create a single tiny game inventory/world prop sprite: a dark graphite projector remote control, laid HORIZONTALLY on a coffee table viewed in near-front orthographic elevation with a little top face visible. Long thin rectangular rounded shape, a few pale buttons and ONE small red power button, a small beige label strip without legible text. Muted desaturated hand-painted pixel art matching a dark Korean office horror side-scrolling game. No glow, outline halo, table or hand, no other objects. True transparent background. Entire remote fully visible, tightly fitted horizontal canvas around 4:1 with a small transparent margin. Should remain recognizable scaled to about 38 pixels wide.
